preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be within the range of 1 to 2500.
The total number of actions q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t in actions) and all(1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= m and 1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c2 <= m for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions)
preconditions.description: Each action must have a valid type t and coordinates within the grid boundaries.

postconditions.description: For each action of type 3, output 'No' if it's not feasible to walk from (r1, c1) to (r2, c2) without crossing barriers, otherwise output 'Yes'.
